template.name: WPR Custom Cloud Simple
template.entry_long: donchian_high(high,{p0}) - donchian_low(low,{p1}) > {p0} and crossabove({p1} * (donchian_high(high,{p2}) - close) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)), -80)
template.exit_long: donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14) > 0 and crossbelow(-100 * (donchian_high(high,14) - close) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)), -20)
template.notes: Williams %R(14) is rebuilt from the documented lookback with a non-zero range guard, crossing up through OversoldLevel=-80 opens the long and crossing down through OverboughtLevel=-20 reverses it, exactly as the reference does. The EA deliberately places no stop-loss or take-profit, so both percent fields are null.
